notes:
Implemented WebSocket handler for real-time chat at /api/v1/ws/{session_id}.

Files changed:
- app/api/websocket.py: Complete WebSocket endpoint with ConnectionManager, session token auth, welcome message, message processing via FallbackAgent + state machine, audit trail on disconnect, graceful error handling
- app/agent/fallback.py: Added process_message() method for end-to-end message processing, fixed intent detection for INFO_VERIFY_PENDING (confirm not agree), added state-specific intents (start, confirm, upload_id, resume)
- app/api/router.py: WebSocket route already included from prior commit
- tests/integration/test_websocket.py: 12 tests covering valid/invalid token, send/receive, invalid messages, disconnect, state persistence, message DB persistence, ConnectionManager unit tests
- tests/unit/test_agent.py: Updated 2 intent tests to match corrected 'confirm' intent

All 232 tests pass (220 unit + 12 integration).

Bug fix: FallbackAgent.detect_intent_regex was returning 'agree' for INFO_VERIFY_PENDING but the transition table uses 'confirm'. This is now corrected, and the process_message() method properly handles all state transitions.
